name: app-shell
title: App shell and menu bar
description: The page frame: a dark menu bar on the left (collapsed to 72px, opens in place on hover and pushes the content over, pin button keeps it open), a scrolling main column with tight padding, and a drawer below 900px. The theme picker lives in the menu bar footer.
whenToUse: Every app page. Start from ui/patterns/page-template.html rather than writing the shell by hand. Change the brand badge, title and nav items only.

variants.description: Current page in the menu (also set aria-current="page").
Button that opens the colour theme menu (five CXO themes).
Collapsed state, set before first paint by the head script.

a11y: The menu bar is an <aside aria-label="Main menu"> with a <nav>. Collapsed items keep their label for screen readers (title + hidden text). Keyboard focus inside the collapsed menu opens it. The drawer closes on Escape.
